cases.name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
cases.text: At the beginning of your end step, exile a card at random from each opponent's graveyard. You may cast any number of spells from among cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs. Then each player who owns a spell you cast this way loses life equal to its mana value.

cases.name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
